503.description: Classified validation, authorization, provider, or configuration error

directoryBearer.description: Separate organization admin-issued SCIM token, hashed at rest.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque 256-bit session token, hashed at rest.

token.description: 256-bit opaque bearer. Store in OS secure storage; never sync.

changeId.description: Optional mutation idempotency key; unique within account.

previewToken.description: Opaque ten-minute review capability returned by writeback/preview. Bound to author, destination, content/actions; consumed atomically with jobs.
